title: Quadrupolar NMR Simulator
description: Interactive first/second-order quadrupolar NMR/NQR spectrum simulator (powder and single crystal) from user-entered Vzz, eta, isotope and magnetic field. Part of aiida-qe-converse, which also provides aiidalab-qe plugins for computing NMR shielding and EFG tensors with QE-CONVERSE.
